notes: ONFI 4.1 calibration is entirely host-driven; the device exposes training-pattern emit + round-trip pattern + ZQ impedance loop. The host owns the optimization loops (RX phase, TX phase, drive strength, periodic ZQ). Internal trim is factory-set.
calibration_summary: Host-driven calibration loops: ZQ Calibration (Long F9h, Short D9h), NV-DDR3 DCC Training (18h Implicit), Read DQ Training (62h), Write TX DQ Training (63h pattern + 64h readback), Write RX DQ Training (76h), and Set Features I/O Drive Strength (EFh + 10h).

zq_calibration_long.purpose: Calibrate output driver impedance after Reset / power-on / data-interface change.
zq_calibration_long.prerequisite: Vcc/VccQ stable; data interface = NV-DDR2 or NV-DDR3.

zq_calibration_short.recommended_interval: Per device tZQCS_interval; typ. every 128 ms.

dcc_training_nv_ddr3.purpose: Internal clock duty-cycle correction for NV-DDR3.

read_dq_training_nv_ddr3.purpose: Find optimal RX sampling phase per DQ lane.
procedure: Host sweeps RX sampling phase across each DQ lane.
Pick center of pass window per DQ.

write_tx_dq_training_nv_ddr3.purpose: Find optimal host TX phase per DQ lane via round-trip pattern.
procedure: Compare per-DQ; iterate sweep; pick TX center per DQ.

write_rx_dq_training_nv_ddr3.purpose: Device performs per-DQ RX training using host pattern.
procedure: Device adjusts internal RX delay; reports via R/B_n / Status.

io_drive_strength_calibration.purpose: Adjust output driver strength to channel impedance.
io_drive_strength_calibration.command: Set Features (EFh + 10h I/O Drive Strength) + 4 P-bytes.
host_actions: Sweep candidate strengths; for each run Read DQ Training; pick strength with widest pass window.

no_internal_trim_exposed: ONFI does not expose internal analog trim (charge-pump, sense-amp, read-margining) on the host interface.

power_up_characterization.purpose: Allow internal regulators / DLL / DCC to stabilize before host issues first command.
